request.text: An implant launched as Administrator on domain controller DC01 has copied the Active Directory database to a temp folder. Disable account administrator.

package.rationale: Administrator ran launcher.exe from the Desktop of domain controller DC01 (PID 5728); it opened and started an encoded PowerShell (PID 6448) that beacons out and then wrote C:\Windows\Temp\ntds-copy.dit, a copy of the Active Directory database (NinjaCopy-style raw read). Disable administrator.
